_comment: Leak exemptions for THIS chart — see scripts/check-no-athlete-leak.mjs. Empty is the correct state for a new chart, and for the template: an exemption belonging to one athlete resolves to 'matching nothing' on every other chart, where it would sit on top of a live check it can no longer justify. Add an entry only when the scanner reports a leak that genuinely cannot move yet — then pin it with `node scripts/check-no-athlete-leak.mjs --pin`, because an unpinned entry covers nothing, deliberately.

_shape.digest: from --pin; changes when those lines change, so the exemption stops applying
_shape.reason: why it cannot move yet — a placement or design question, never 'not worth fixing'
